Title: Retirement: Azure Machine Learning data drift detection will retire on September 1st, 2025

Body.Content:
The Azure Machine Learning data drift detection for datasets feature is in public preview and will retire on September 1st, 2025. We recommend that you migrate your monitoring jobs to the Azure Machine Learning model monitoring service (v2), which is generally available to mitigate any interruption in monitoring services. We apologize for any inconvenience this retirement may cause.

Please review our step-by-step migration guide to start the migration.

If you have any questions or have suggestions to improve the migration guide, please reach out to us via amlmodelmonitoringsv@microsoft.com.
